content.value: on a speculative design project that imagines a future in which technology eases psychological and physiological stress through advanced therapeutic systems. We proposed decentralised AI that reads physiological arousal and lets users shape how their devices respond. The work shown (ads, system diagrams, and interface demonstrations) is an artefact from that world.
